svg.aria-label: Three plain chatbot robots stand in a row, each with a small price tag bearing a percent sign hanging at its side. A surprised doctor stands apart, pointing toward a small orange scanner robot. Above the scanner floats a bar chart labeled ACCURACY, its tallest bar right over the scanner's head.
